headlines.text: Hot October CPI print cements ~90% odds of a December Fed rate hike, keeping Treasury yields elevated
Nasdaq climbs ~1.3% and S&P 500 adds ~0.9% as Nvidia, AMD and Intel rally despite the hot CPI data
